maintenance_fixtures.scope: Disposable fixtures only; canonical primary progress unchanged.

limitations: Organizational lines are containment, never prerequisite or foreign-key edges. Wide expanded trees use canvas scrolling or branch focus.
Completion evidence is declared and reviewed; the UI does not watch the filesystem or execute the 720 future v3 acceptance obligations.
Native optional source-document links require the adjacent documentation; the core HTML needs no runtime companion assets.
